value.rationale: Yoneda–Yoneda identifies an E/n mean guarantee for randomized cyclic rotation choices, but the mean does not quantify variability or tail behavior. The exact law resolves all higher moments and risk probabilities. The sharp simultaneously attainable variance envelopes show which conflict-graph structures create deterministic, low-risk or high-risk randomized EF1 baselines at fixed edge density. Forest factorization gives a tractable full law; the simple triangle proves cycle dependence is a substantive obstruction. These features supply useful structural sensitivity information for randomized allocation, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
